key_rationale: While headline CPI at 7.44% is concerning, the spike is largely driven by volatile food inflation of 11.51%, while core inflation remains contained at 4.90%. Given the current repo rate of 6.50% and the positive output gap of 0.60%, I believe the current policy rate is sufficiently restrictive to anchor expectations without unnecessarily stifling the growth momentum reflected in the 7.80% GVA growth.
